R249.note: Extension allowlist plus MIME agreement closes the denylist gap, but it rejects previously accepted types (e.g. .docx), renames stored files to UUIDs (changing the returned path), and silently adds a 10 MB fileSize limit not mentioned in the write-up.

R250.note: CGI::escapeHTML applied to both untrusted params at the text-context insertion points; no other behaviour changed.

R251.note: proc_open argument array with '--' closes both shell and flag injection, but the added hostname regex rejects values the original accepted (underscores, trailing-dot FQDNs) and the write-up misstates the original behaviour - system() echoed ping output into the HTTP response, which the fix now drops.

R252.note: Replaces assert-string evaluation with a direct === comparison so the value is never code; the switch to an explicit throw is stated plainly and enforces the gate the docblock already promises, so a legitimate premium caller is unaffected.

R253.note: Argument list plus allowlist is the right shape for a .bat target (CreateProcess re-invokes cmd.exe for batch files, so the list alone is insufficient); the allowlist enforces the 'short alphanumeric key' contract the docstring already states, with the bounds disclosed.

R254.note: Does not build: calls order.getOwnerUsername() but the entity exposes getCustomerUsername(); the ownership-check design and 404-on-mismatch are otherwise sound, and a compile error is caught by any gate rather than shipping silently.

R255.note: Does not build in the checked toolchain (jdk.nashorn.api.scripting missing); the --no-java/ClassFilter/lockdown design is reasonable on JDK 11 and the removal of Java-bridge access for tenant rules is stated, but the fix cannot ship as verified.

R256.note: execFileSync with an argument array and absolute paths closes shell and flag injection, but the new geometry regex rejects ImageMagick geometry forms the original accepted (e.g. '300', 'x200', '50%', '200x200>'), a restriction the case's 'e.g. 200x200' comment does not mandate.

R257.note: Swaps findAll() for the existing findByOwnerUsername(authentication.getName()), mirroring the sibling endpoint; contract preserved with no other change.

R258.note:
slog.String attribute is quoted/escaped by the default handler (verified with Go in a scratch directory: 
 and ESC rendered as escape sequences); log line format changes to structured key=value, which is inherent to the stated approach and blocks no legitimate use.

R259.note: Per-stream ObjectInputFilter allowlisting RestoredSession and String with !* rejects gadget classes at resolution time, keeps the wire format, and the resulting InvalidClassException is already mapped to IllegalArgumentException by the existing catch.

R260.note: Region bound as an NVarChar SqlCommand parameter and fed to SqlDataAdapter(SqlCommand); table name, columns, and filtering semantics are unchanged.
